guardrails: Only completed V11 claims with MATCHED telemetry and schema-v12+ generated routing may train automatic routing.
Manual overrides, unrouted work, retrospective runs, active claims, and invalid outcomes never train routing adjustments.
Worker adjustments require matched task-context evidence; raw worker averages are diagnostic only.
Missing evidence produces zero adjustment, never a penalty.
Positive and negative learned adjustments are bounded independently.
Routing-learning residuals are observational and must not be described as causal worker-quality estimates.
Outcome-linked signals update the learner when outcomes arrive; prior routing decisions are not rewritten.
